# Liyuk

> An independent writing and project archive about technology, products, leadership, research, and field notes.

## Primary sections

- [Writing](https://liyuk.github.io/writing/): Chinese-language original essays and notes.
- [Projects](https://liyuk.github.io/projects/): Products, tools, and experiments.
- [Research](https://liyuk.github.io/research/): Papers, research notes, and talks.
- [Photos](https://liyuk.github.io/photos/): Curated photography and field notes.
- [English interface](https://liyuk.github.io/en/): The same content with an English UI shell (article bodies remain Chinese).

## Machine-readable resources

- [RSS](https://liyuk.github.io/rss.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://liyuk.github.io/sitemap-index.xml)
